summary: Investigated why `/skill:continue` did not appear in the Gizmo composer, traced the root cause to Slapdash defining `continue` as a prompt template in `.pi/prompts/` (a directory Gizmo does not scan), then began scoping changes to make Gizmo discover and inject Pi-style project-local prompts.
decisions: Treat `/skill:continue` as not-a-bug: Slapdash's `continue.md` is a prompt template, so it surfaces as `/continue`, not `/skill:continue`, and only `SKILL.md` resources receive the `/skill:` prefix.

Plan to extend Gizmo's prompt discovery to include project-local `.pi/prompts/` (in addition to existing `.gizmo/prompts` and `.agents/prompts`) so Slapdash-authored prompts become visible without relocation.
errors: rg regex parse error: `(?:skillCommands()` has an unclosed group; the grep against `skillCommands(` in `apps/agent-server/src` failed and was not retried in this segment.
